description: Na₂FeCAsO₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/m space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.94 Å. Fe is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted FeO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent AsO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 2.00-2.13 Å. C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of C-O bond distances ranging from 1.26-1.33 Å. As is bonded to four O atoms to form AsO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent FeO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 43-54°. There are a spread of As-O bond distances ranging from 1.71-1.74 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Na and one C atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na, one Fe, and one C atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted tetrahedral geometry to two equivalent Na, one Fe, and one C atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na, one Fe, and one As atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to two equivalent Na, one Fe, and one As atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Fe, and one As atom.
